James Handy has died aged 81

Top Gun: Maverick star James Handy has died at the age of 81 after being fatally stabbed in a shocking attack.

Renowned for his appearances in numerous productions, including Jumanji, Arachnophobia and Top Gun: Maverick, James was found outside a Tarzana residence in California on Wednesday, June 3, with a stab wound to his chest. He was rushed to the hospital, where he was subsequently pronounced dead.

Authorities identified the suspect as Michael Gledhill, 44, who contacted 911 prior to officers arriving on the scene. Michael made the startling statement to dispatchers, "I am the son of man, I just killed the man of sin," according to officials. It comes weeks after BBC Hope Street star Finnian Garbutt passed away at the age of 28.

Officers who responded to the scene reported that Michael flagged them down, admitting he was the individual they were looking for. "On Wednesday, June 3, 2026, around 9:30 a.m., West Valley area patrol officers responded to a radio call of unknown trouble in the 19200 block of Erwin Street," read the official police statement obtained by The Irish Star.

It continued, "The 911 caller stated, 'I am the son of man, I just killed the man of sin.' Upon their arrival, officers discovered 81-year-old James Handy in the front yard of the residence, unconscious and suffering from a stab wound to his chest."

Fans have paid tribute to the actor

"The victim was transported to local hospital by Los Angeles Fire Department paramedics, where he was pronounced deceased. The suspect flagged down nearby responding officers, telling them he was the one they were looking for. The suspect resides at the location with his mother, who is the victim's girlfriend," the police statement continued.

Michael has now been arrested and booked for murder, with his bail set at $2 million, reports the Mirror US. Thus far, investigators haven't publicly disclosed the possible motive behind the tragic incident. Numerous fans of James have taken to X, formerly known as Twitter, to express their grief.

"That's wild and so sad. James Handy was one of those 'that guy' actors you loved seeing pop up everywhere. RIP legend," one person posted on X.

He was discovered outside a home in Tarzana, California(Image: ABC7)

Another stated, "It is profoundly saddening to learn of this news. James Handy was a quintessential 'that guy' actor whose presence was always a welcome addition. Rest in peace, legend."

Meanwhile, a third user shared, "Absolutely heartbreaking. 81 years old and taken like this... sending prayers to everyone who knew him." Another person remarked, "What always strikes me in moments like these is how fragile life really is.

"One day someone is part of stories that entertain millions and the next they're gone. Fame, status and success don't make anyone immune to life's uncertainties. Rest in peace James."
